title: Site card
description: A site built with Pattern Dump, as a card: its name, a picture across the card, one short line and one link to the page about it. On a page, inside <pd-components-site-cards>: <pd-components-site-card title="…" image="/assets/…" alt="…" line="…" href="…" link-label="…" />.

title.description: The site's name, as the card's heading (not a link), above the picture

image.description: A picture of the site, a raster image in the assets: across the card's width under the name. On a phone the slot asks for half the card's width: a smaller file, at a little less sharpness, so the home page's load stays as light as without the cards

alt.description: The picture's alt text, one sentence: what the site looks like, which the name and the line don't say. Never "Screenshot of", and not the name again

line.description: One short line about the site, under ten words: what makes someone want to see it

href.description: Where the link leads: the page about the site

linkLabel.description: The link's text: say where it leads ("See how the demo is built"), never "Read more"

level.description: The name's heading level: one below the heading the cards sit under. The list's level, when it sets one, wins
